strNameFriendly: Phobos' Asterel N1 Polaris Auto Nav Module
strNameShort: Phobos' Asterel N1 Polaris Auto Nav Module
strDesc: Let Polaris take the long approach. Uses the torch where allowed, with RCS for fallback and close control. Set a stopping distance; hull clearance and no-wake rules still apply, including below 5,000 km. Dock needs its own command and clearance. Avoidance uses tracked contacts. Repair or Restore for reuse; dismantling leaves board residue. N2 adds continuous following.

strNameFriendly: Phobos' Asterel N1 Polaris Auto Nav Module (Damaged)
strNameShort: Phobos' Asterel N1 Polaris Auto Nav Module (Damaged)
strDesc: A damaged Phobos' Asterel N1 Polaris Auto Nav Module. Repair with two small electronic parts, then Restore its remaining wear before use. Fits a Polaris navigation station. Dismantling retains 0.4 kg of board residue.

strNameFriendly: Phobos' Asterel N2 Polaris Pursuit Module
strNameShort: Phobos' Asterel N2 Polaris Pursuit Module
strDesc: Keep company with a moving contact. Includes navigation and docking; Rendezvous matches motion once, while Follow keeps pace. Weapons need a separate N3 Fire Control System. Pauses after loading. Avoidance uses tracked contacts; catching a ship intact is never assured.

strNameFriendly: Phobos' Asterel N2 Polaris Pursuit Module (Damaged)
strNameShort: Phobos' Asterel N2 Polaris Pursuit Module (Damaged)
strDesc: A damaged Phobos' Asterel N2 Polaris Pursuit Module. Repair with two small electronic parts, then Restore its remaining wear before use. Fits a Polaris navigation station. Dismantling retains 0.4 kg of board residue.

strNameFriendly: Phobos' Asterel N3 Polaris Fire Control System
strNameShort: Phobos' Asterel N3 Polaris Fire Control System
strDesc: Choose the target and how many volleys to send. N3 handles firing checks and optional RCS Auto Aim. Cease Fire holds offensive fire until Return to ship controls. Needs a usable sensor track and permitted, ready weapons. Loading a save keeps fire on hold; it never rearms the system.

strNameFriendly: Phobos' Asterel N3 Polaris Fire Control System (Damaged)
strNameShort: Phobos' Asterel N3 Polaris Fire Control System (Damaged)
strDesc: A damaged Phobos' Asterel N3 Polaris Fire Control System. Repair before use. The working unit controls selected volleys and optional RCS aiming; it still needs a usable sensor track and permitted, ready weapons. Loading keeps offensive fire on hold.
